book.title: Matta Laɓara na Mbǝnggǝn aten Yeeso

content: Chichiiya Yeeso
Kulo thlǝmngya chichiiya Yeeso Ƙǝrǝsti ya, chichid Ndauda tǝ Ibrahim.
Ibrahim nggǝtgha Ishaku, Ishaku nggǝtgha Yakubu. Yakubu nggǝtgha Yahuda tǝ wan manggighǝn.
Yahuda nggǝtgha Peres tǝ Dzara. Ma ndan ndǝna Tamar. Peres nggǝtgha Hesron, Hesron nggǝtgha Aram,
Aram nggǝtgha Aminadab, Aminadab nggǝtgha Nashon, Nashon nggǝtgha Salmon.
Salmon Nggǝtgha Mboz. Man ndǝna Rahap. Mboz nggǝtgha Obed. Man ndǝna Ruth. Obed nggǝtgha Djeshi,
Njessi nggǝtgha kutǝra Ndauda. Ndauda nggǝtgha Sulemanu. Man ndǝna Mbasheba, nu mǝra Uriya.
Sulemanu nggǝtgha Rehobom, Rehobom nggǝtgha Abidja, Abidja nggǝtgha Asa,
Asa nggǝtgha Djehoshafat, Djehoshafat nggǝtgha Djoram, Djoram nggǝtgha Adzariya,
Adzariya nggǝtgha Djothlam, Djothlam nggǝtgha Ahas, Ahas nggǝtgha Hedzekiya,
Hedzekiya nggǝtgha Manasa, Manasa nggǝtgha Aman, Aman nggǝtgha Djosiya,
Djosiya nggǝtgha Djekoniya
tǝ wanmanggighǝn, a sayidɗi ƙǝsang ngganda nafiya Yahuda ngyaɓang tsaurha nda kanda fa hu chehweed Mbabila ɗǝ.
A kwasamadɗi ɗǝna nda tǝ kanda a Mbabila ɗǝ, Djokoniya nggǝtgha Sheyaltiyel, Sheyaltiyel nggǝtgha Dzerubabel,
Dzerubabel nggǝtgha Abihudu, Abihudu nggǝtgha Eliyakim, Eliyakim nggǝtgha Adzor,
Adzor nggǝtgha Dzadok, Dzadok nggǝtgha Akim, Akim nggǝtgha Eliyud,
Eliyud nggǝtgha Eleyadza, Eleyadza nggǝtgha Mattan, Mattan nggǝtgha Yakubu,
Yakubu nggǝtgha Yisufu, chimad Mairamu. Mairamu nggǝtgha Yeeso na nda aarha Ƙǝrǝsti.

Chichiiya kumkap faɗa a thlakh mbǝd Ibrahim ɗǝgha thlakh mbǝd Ndauda ɗǝ. Thliirha a thlakh mbǝd Ndauda ɗǝgha hu sayidɗa ɗǝ ngyaɓang nanda tsaurha kanda fa a Mbabila, chichiiya kumkap faɗa ni. Thiirha ƙǝm a sayidɗi mal nanda Mbabila ɗǝgha hu sayidɗa ɗǝ nggǝt nanda Ƙǝrǝsti chichiiya kumkap faɗa ni.
Nggǝtta Yeeso
Kulo kwaman nggǝtta Yeeso Ƙǝrǝsti ya. A sayidɗi ngwanna Yisufu Mairamu man Yeeso, amma kanda kula kakhrha, ƙǝlagha Mairamu hai, nǝghǝn ahur yi Sǝsǝna tǝ Peɗǝnda.
Yisufu ka niifa ni mbǝ midghǝn sǝ a fǝrang shilee nǝn Mairamu a yid fiya wa, ahu numadghǝn na midghǝn sǝ a kalghǝnǝn hai ɓǝɓee.
Amma ndǝghǝn hu numadɗi kee, ɓagha tǝthlǝnda Faara thlǝmadghǝn ɓa hu sǝsǝniirha ndanggǝn, “Yisufu, wan Ndauda, a tǝrǝmna kakh Mairamu wa, ƙǝsǝr huryidɗi keeghǝn yi Sǝsǝna tǝ Peɗǝnda ni.
Nǝn a nggǝt wee hǝshin, ɗǝfang thlǝma na Yeeso
Ƙǝsǝr ndǝghǝn ni a hǝrghang nafiyighǝn ahu ɗimiyid ndan.”
Ənggini heu ya katǝra nǝn hai ka a lǝɗang ngganda ˈya ndana annabi.

content.text: “Na wutararha a ɗǝfrha hur nggǝt wee hǝshin nǝn

content: Thlǝmɗi ndaarha ni, “Faara nǝghǝn tǝ ƙǝm ha.”
Mehenna Yisufu sǝ a ɓeena, takkwa ǝn ɗanǝn pǝrangna tǝthlǝnda Faara, kahanggǝn Mairamu.
Amma sǝngwa ndǝn wee nuwun wa, ƙǝl a kwasamadɗi nggǝt nǝn wee hǝshin, ɗǝfang thlǝma nǝn Yeeso.

footnotes.text: Djekoniya:sǝn ndan ƙǝm tǝ thlǝma “Djehoyakin”. Ƙǝlang 2 Kutǝrya 25:27
Yeeso:Thlǝmɗi “Yeeso” tǝ mii Helenaya ni, ndǝna “Djeshiwa” tǝ mii Ibraniyaya. Thlǝmɗi ndaarha ni, “Faara tǝ hǝrǝkrha ni”
